movies.title: Baaghi 4
movies.description: Baaghi 4 is a 2025 Hindi action thriller and the fourth installment of the Baaghi franchise, following Ronnie as he emerges from a coma and fights violent threats and personal turmoil with high-octane action and revenge.

movies.title: Border 2
movies.description: Border 2 is a Hindi-language epic action war film and a standalone sequel to the 1997 classic Border, portraying bravery, sacrifice, and patriotism through intense battle sequences and emotional storytelling.

movies.title: Chhaava
movies.description: Chhaava is a 2025 Hindi-language historical action film based on the life of Sambhaji Maharaj, the second ruler of the Maratha Empire, blending epic drama and battlefield action.

movies.title: Dhurandhar
movies.description: A fast-paced spy thriller where an intelligence officer goes rogue to uncover a deep-rooted conspiracy within the system. The film is packed with suspense, high-stakes missions, and patriotic fervor.

movies.title: Dil Dosti Aur Dogs
movies.description: A heartwarming comedy-drama that explores the unique bond between humans and their canine companions. The story revolves for a group of friends whose lives are transformed by the arrival of a dog, leading to chaos, laughter, and emotional realizations.

movies.title: Housefull 5
movies.description: The fifth installment of the hit comedy franchise, set entirely on a luxury cruise ship. This time, the confusion multiplies with a murder mystery twist amidst the usual slapstick humor and mistaken identities.

movies.title: Jolly LLB 3
movies.description: The third chapter in the courtroom comedy drama series, bringing together the original Jolly and his successor. The two lawyers face off in a high-profile case that tackles social issues with humor and wit.

movies.title: Kesari Chapter 2
movies.description: A spiritual sequel to the 2019 hit, this film delves into another untold chapter of Indian history, focusing on the Jallianwala Bagh massacre and the subsequent legal battle for justice led by C. Sankaran Nair.

movies.title: Sikandar
movies.description: An action-entertainer featuring a larger-than-life protagonist who stands up against social injustice. The film combines mass appeal with a strong emotional core and high-octane action sequences.

movies.title: Sitare Zameen Par
movies.description: A spiritual successor to Taare Zameen Par, this sports comedy-drama focuses on Down Syndrome. It follows a coach who trains a team of specially-abled athletes, highlighting their spirit, challenges, and triumphs.

movies.title: Son of Sardaar 2
movies.description: The sequel to the 2012 blockbuster, returning with more turban-powered action and comedy. The story follows Jassi on a new adventure in the UK, dealing with family feuds and hilarious misunderstandings.

movies.title: War 2
movies.description: The sixth installment in the YRF Spy Universe pits the lethal agent Kabir against a formidable new adversary, Vikram, a special units officer. The film traverses the globe with high-stakes espionage, shifting alliances, and adrenaline-pumping action sequences as two spies clash in a battle of wits and brawn.
